Forced by boot configuration; cannot be changed here

Stop the listed kernel modules from loading at boot. Blocking a module the system depends on can make the device hang on the boot logo or bootloop (e.g. MediaTek mkp on some devices). Only enable this if you know the modules are safe to block on your device. To recover, flash the stock boot / init_boot image with fastboot.

Run a trusted kernel installer using the current slot. Root required.

This ZIP runs with root and may modify multiple partitions. The installer controls which partitions and slots are written; FinaSU does not override the slot or refresh ksud. A successful install does not guarantee bootability, and failure may leave partial changes. Existing boot-image backups may not cover these changes. Confirm device compatibility and prepare a recovery image before continuing.
